verdict.rationale: Reflect has its own OAuth2 REST API, but it covers only a small slice of the UI. It can list graphs, get and create bookmarked links, append to daily notes, create notes and fetch the current user. The docs say outright that note contents cannot be served through the API because of end-to-end encryption, so parity with the UI is plainly not delivered. Missing for 10: reading or searching note contents via API, editing or deleting notes, backlinks/tags/filters, AI palette and chat, publishing, note history, import/export, any documented parity commitment, versioning policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Our supports appending data to your notes, returning a list of the links you've bookmarked, and a few other things.
Your notes contents are end-to-end encrypted. Our servers can't read the contents of your notes, so we can't serve them up in the API.
